commonSettings.label: Idle session timeout (seconds)
commonSettings.description: How long a chat session stays warm after its last request before it is closed. 0 keeps it until the agent stops.

commonSettings.label: Idle agent shutdown (minutes)
commonSettings.description: Stop the agent process after this many idle minutes. 0 never stops it. It starts again on the next request.

commonSettings.label: Dump requests (debug)
commonSettings.description: Write each request Copilot sends to a JSON file in the extension's storage folder. The files hold the whole prompt, so keep this off unless you are debugging.

settings.label: Auth preference
settings.description: Which credentials the Claude agent uses when both an API key and a signed-in account (OAuth) are available. Changing it restarts the agent.
optionDescriptions: Use the saved API key when there is one, otherwise the signed-in account.
Use the saved API key. Without one, the agent falls back to its signed-in account.
Always use the signed-in account and ignore the saved API key and the key environment variables.

settings.label: Auth preference
settings.description: Which credentials the Codex agent uses when both an OpenAI API key and a ChatGPT account are available. Changing it restarts the agent.
optionDescriptions: Use the saved OpenAI API key when there is one, otherwise the ChatGPT account.
Use the saved OpenAI API key. Without one, the agent falls back to its ChatGPT account.
Always use the ChatGPT account: the saved API key is ignored and CODEX_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY are withheld from the agent.

settings.label: Largest context window
settings.description: Ask Codex for the largest context window each model allows instead of its default. Models that cannot be raised keep their default. A larger window delays compaction, so long chats re-send more history on every turn and use up your plan limits faster. Changing it restarts the agent.

settings.label: Agent command
settings.description: Program that starts the ACP server. Leave empty to use the Antigravity server (agy_acp_server) the extension downloads.

settings.label: Agent arguments
settings.description: Arguments for the program. Leave empty for the default (none).

settings.label: Use the agent's built-in tools
settings.description: Let the Antigravity agent use its own file, shell and search tools. When off (default), the extension asks Antigravity not to use them so Copilot chat tools can do the work. The extension automatically approves agent permission requests; built-in tools do not use Copilot confirmations.

settings.label: Auth preference
settings.description: Which credentials the agent uses when both a Gemini API key and a signed-in account are available. Changing it restarts the agent.
optionDescriptions: Use the saved API key when there is one, otherwise the signed-in account.
Use the saved API key. Without one, the agent falls back to its signed-in account.
Always use the signed-in account and ignore the saved API key and the key environment variables.
